title: SBOMber canonical scan output
description: Contract for the canonical scan output shared across SBOMber components. Separates four distinct identities so that a component, a specific occurrence of it in a workspace, a vulnerability finding against it, and an observed usage of it are never conflated into one record. See docs/design/canonical-scan.md for the rationale and current implementation status.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of this schema, independent of the SBOMber CLI version. Bump the major segment on any breaking change to a required field or identity key.

scan.description: Metadata about the scan run that produced this document.

root.description: Absolute or repo-relative path that was scanned.

components.description: Identity 1: a component is an exact versioned package, identified solely by its PURL. Two components with the same name but different versions are different components. Deduplicated: at most one entry per purl in this array.

occurrences.description: Identity 2: a package occurrence is a specific appearance of a component in a workspace — the same component PURL can have multiple occurrences if it appears under different manifests, workspaces, or dependency paths (e.g. two different resolved versions under different node_modules paths are two occurrences, not one).

findings.description: Identity 3: a vulnerability finding is keyed by (vulnerability ID, component PURL) — not by occurrence. The same finding applies to every occurrence of that exact component PURL.

usageObservations.description: Identity 4: a usage observation ties a package occurrence to a concrete call site — an imported symbol, file, line, and call expression. This identity is defined by the schema for forward compatibility but is NOT populated by the current SBOMber scanner (no static call-site analysis exists yet). Expect this array to be empty until that capability ships; do not treat an empty array here as evidence a component is unused.

purl.description: Package URL, e.g. pkg:npm/lodash@4.18.1. This is the sole identity key for a component.

version.description: The exact resolved/installed version, never a semver range.

occurrenceId.description: Stable identity key for this identity class: componentPurl + workspace + manifestPath + dependencyPath. Two occurrences with the same componentPurl but different dependencyPath (e.g. nested under different parents at different resolved versions) MUST have different occurrenceId values.

workspace.description: Repository or workspace name this occurrence was found in.

manifestPath.description: Path to the manifest/lockfile this occurrence was declared or resolved in, relative to workspace root.

dependencyPath.description: Chain from the workspace root to this occurrence, e.g. ["repo", "webpack", "lodash"]. Distinguishes occurrences of the same component reached via different parents.

findingId.description: Stable identity key for this identity class: vulnerabilityId + componentPurl.

vulnerabilityId.description: e.g. a CVE or GHSA identifier.

componentPurl.description: References components[].purl. Note: NOT an occurrenceId — a finding applies to the component everywhere it occurs.

source.description: Scanner or feed that produced this finding, e.g. grype, kev, epss, ghsa.

symbol.description: The imported symbol observed at the call site, e.g. a function or class name.

file.description: Source file the usage was observed in, relative to workspace root.

callSite.description: The literal call expression observed, e.g. "_.debounce(fn, 200)".
